calculation.description: Ratio of 5-day return to absolute 20-day return. Values > 1 mean short-term momentum is accelerating relative to the medium-term trend; values < 1 mean deceleration. At the cross-asset level this acts as a contrarian/reversion signal: strong acceleration predicts negative forward returns (mean reversion across instruments). Validated on 15-asset cross-asset universe 2020-01..2035-12.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across 2020-01..2035-12 using all 15 tradable cross-asset instruments. Covers COVID crash, 2021-22 inflation/rate hiking, 2023 AI rally, 2024-35 crypto/commodity cycles, and 2029-35 multi-regime period. Mean IC negative across both halves of sample, indicating stable reversion signal. Decay analysis shows strongest predictive power at 10d horizon. At 20d horizon IC flips to positive (trend re-emergence).
